releaseNotes: v1.19.0: the big features release. Profiles: add a photo, bio and social links — end-to-end encrypted, visible only to your contacts. Share your location as a pin or LIVE for 15–120 minutes (works in background). Share contacts with a one-tap Add button. Shared checklists you both can edit together. Tag any message — photos, voice notes, locations — with your own labels. New QR invite links: scanning with any camera opens Dunes (or the download page). Redesigned Telegram-style settings, bigger voice recorder with wave effects, smoother and faster chats, and more reliable reconnection on flaky networks.
